Bug_Title: USELESS_STRING: Invocation of toString on an unnamed array (DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ANONYMOUS_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes toString on an (anonymous) array.  Calling toString on an array generates a fairly useless result
such as [C@16f0472. Consider using Arrays.toString to convert the array into a readable
String that gives the contents of the array. See Programming Puzzlers, chapter 3, puzzle 12.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by invoking the toString method directly on an array named 'numbers'. This results in a useless string representation of the array such as [I@16f0472 instead of a readable string showing the contents of the array.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of the ArrayToStringBug class, which incorrectly uses the toString method on an array. The expected result is a string representation of the array contents '[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]', but the actual result is a useless string like '[I@16f0472', causing the test to fail.
